question: What body part do we use to clap to the music? 👏
explanation: Super! We use our hands to clap and make a fun rhythm together! 👏

question: If you want to make a stomping sound, what do you use? 👢
explanation: Awesome! Stomping our feet makes a big, strong beat! 🥁

question: What do we call a song we sing to babies to help them sleep? 😴
explanation: Great job! A lullaby is very soft and sweet for sleeping. 🛌

question: What do you do when you sing with your mouth closed? 🤐
explanation: Fantastic! Humming makes a lovely buzz sound without opening your mouth! 🐝

question: Which instrument do you hit with sticks or hands? 🥁
explanation: Brilliant! Drums are perfect for keeping a steady beat. 🎶

question: A Bansuri is made from what material? 🎋
explanation: Super! A Bansuri is a beautiful wooden flute made of bamboo. 🌳
hint: Pandas love to eat this plant.

question: How do you play a Bansuri (flute)? 🌬️
explanation: Awesome! We blow air softly into the flute to make sweet music! 🎶

question: What do we call the words of a song? 📝
explanation: Great job! Lyrics are the story or words we sing in a song. 🎤

question: When music is very fast, what do we want to do? 🏃
explanation: Fantastic! Fast music gives us energy to move and dance! ⚡
hint: Moving your body to the beat.

question: What do we shake to make a rattling sound? 🪇
explanation: Super! Shakers are full of little beads that sound amazing when moved! ✨
hint: You move it back and forth.

question: If you sing very softly, you are doing what? 🤫
explanation: Awesome! Singing softly or whispering is great for quiet songs. 🌙

question: What do we call a group of people singing together? 🧑‍🎤👩‍🎤
explanation: Great job! A choir is a team of singers making beautiful music together! 🎼

question: What do you use to sing louder for a big crowd? 🎤
explanation: Fantastic! A microphone makes your singing voice nice and loud! 🔊
hint: Singers hold this in their hand.

question: Which animal makes a high-pitched singing sound? 🐦
explanation: Super! Birds chirp and sing beautiful high notes in the morning! 🌅

question: What do we wear on our ankles to make sound while dancing? 💃
explanation: Awesome! Ghungroo bells chime perfectly when we stomp our feet! 🔔

question: When we snap our fingers, what do we hear? 🫰
explanation: Great job! Finger snaps make a sharp, happy click sound! 🫰

question: What is the steady pulse in music called? 💓
explanation: Fantastic! The beat is like the heart of the music, it keeps us together! ❤️

question: How do we play a guitar? 🎸
explanation: Super! We pluck or strum the guitar strings to make sweet tunes. 🎶
hint: You use your fingers on lines.

question: What emotion do you feel with a happy song? 😊
explanation: Awesome! Happy songs make us smile and feel full of joy! 🌈

question: If two friends sing together, what is it called? 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
explanation: Great job! A duet is a special song just for two people. 🎵

question: What shape is a musical Triangle instrument? 🔺
explanation: Fantastic! It is shaped just like a triangle and makes a 'ding' sound! 🔔

question: What do we call a song that is sung by one person alone? 🧍
explanation: Super! Singing a solo means you are the star singing all by yourself! 🎤

question: What do we do to learn a song really well? 🔁
explanation: Awesome! Practice helps us remember the words and sing perfectly! 🏆

question: Which instrument has black and white keys? 🎹
explanation: Great job! You press the black and white keys on a piano to make music. 🎶
hint: It is big and has keys.

question: What sound does a Dholak make? 🪘
explanation: Fantastic! A Dholak is a cool hand drum that goes dum-dum! 🪘

question: What do we call making music sounds using only our body? 🧍
explanation: Super! Clapping, stomping, and snapping are fun body percussion! 💪

question: What is the speed of music called? ⏱️
explanation: Awesome! Tempo tells us if the song is fast like a cheetah or slow like a turtle! 🐢

question: Who guides the choir to sing together? 🧑‍🏫
explanation: Great job! The conductor moves their hands to help everyone sing in time! 🎵
hint: They stand in front of the singers.

question: What are the round, metal instruments that crash together? 💥
explanation: Fantastic! Cymbals make a big, bright splash sound when they crash! ✨

question: If you pat your legs to the music, what are you hitting? 👖
explanation: Super! Patting your knees is a great way to keep the beat while sitting! 🪑
hint: They are in the middle of your legs.

question: What is the main tune of a song called? 🎶
explanation: Awesome! The melody is the beautiful part of the song that we hum or sing! 🎤

question: What instrument has bellows that you pump with your hand? 🎹
explanation: Great job! We pump the harmonium to push air and press keys to play notes! 🎶
hint: It looks like a small piano box.

question: What is a song that tells a sad story? 😢
explanation: Fantastic! Sad songs are slow and gentle, helping us understand feelings. 💙

question: What happens when you blow into a whistle? 🌬️
explanation: Super! Whistles make a very loud, sharp sound perfect for keeping rhythm! 🎵

question: What part of the song repeats many times? 🔄
explanation: Awesome! The chorus is the catchy part of the song everyone loves to sing together! 🎤

question: What are the two drums in a Tabla pair played with? 🤲
explanation: Great job! Tabla players use their fingers and palms to tap amazing beats! 🥁

question: When soldiers walk to a beat, what song do they use? 🪖
explanation: Fantastic! Marching songs have a strong beat: one, two, one, two! 🥾

question: If a song makes you laugh, what kind of song is it? 😂
explanation: Super! Funny songs have silly words and bouncy tunes to make us giggle! 😄
hint: It makes you smile and laugh.

question: Where do singers stand to perform for an audience? 🎭
explanation: Awesome! A stage is raised up high so everyone can see the wonderful singers! 🎤

question: What do we use to listen to music privately? 🎧
explanation: Great job! Headphones put the music right into your ears quietly! 🎶
hint: You wear them on your head.

question: What is the very high sound made by puckering your lips? 😗
explanation: Fantastic! Whistling creates a happy, high tune just like a little bird! 🐦
hint: Blowing air out of round lips.

question: What does a tambourine have around its edges? ✨
explanation: Super! The little metal jingles shake and sparkle when you hit the tambourine! 🪇

question: How do we hold a Bansuri? 🤲
explanation: Awesome! We hold the Bansuri sideways across our face to blow into it perfectly. 🎋

question: What do people watching a music show do at the end? 👏
explanation: Great job! The audience claps to say 'Thank you, that was great music!' 🎉

question: If you play a drum very softly, what is the volume? 🔉
explanation: Fantastic! Hitting the drum gently makes a nice, quiet tippy-tap sound. 🥁

question: What do we call the people who write songs? ✍️
explanation: Super! Songwriters think of the amazing melodies and fun lyrics for us to sing! 📝

question: What happens if you sing in a big, empty cave? 🗣️
explanation: Awesome! The sound bounces off the walls, making your voice repeat like magic! ⛰️

question: When we sing, what part of our body makes the sound? 🗣️
explanation: Great job! Our vocal cords vibrate in our throat to make wonderful singing voices! 🎤

question: What do we do to make sure our instruments sound perfect? 🔧
explanation: Fantastic! Tuning makes sure every note sounds happy, beautiful, and correct! 🎸

question: Why do we sing and play music? ❤️
explanation: Super! Music brings us joy, happiness, and is always so much fun to share! ✨
